question: For identityless creates and attempted-but-unconfirmed deletions, should cleanup remain bound to the exact creating credential, or must this provider capture a stable fal account/workspace identity before credential rotation is supported?
rationale: Cross-credential destructive recovery affects both accidental deletion safety and the possibility of stranding billable resources after normal key rotation; source review cannot decide the intended operator contract.

options.title: Keep Exact-Credential Fail-Closed
options.body: Launch with the current conservative boundary, clearly document that the creating credential must remain available through indeterminate recovery, and prove that behavior in the funded canary.

options.title: Require Stable Account Identity
options.body: Pause merge until a reliable fal account or workspace identifier is persisted and both same-account rotation and cross-account rejection are tested.

recommendation.title: Keep Exact-Credential Fail-Closed
recommendation.body: Launch with the current conservative boundary, clearly document that the creating credential must remain available through indeterminate recovery, and prove that behavior in the funded canary.

likelyOwner.reason: They implemented the latest lifecycle and credential-boundary hardening and explicitly identified this decision in the July 17, 2026 review comment.
